Type: multicolor patterned lumbar cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: woven cotton fabric with a printed pattern
Colors: white background, orange, lime and dark green, burgundy, blush, slate blue, brown
Shape: long rectangular cushion with vertical rows of small angular geometric shapes like confetti, airy white ground, plain edges, medium size
Feel: cheerful, lively, fresh
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, green plants, orange accents; Scandinavian, retro or mid-century rooms
